text: Floyd you headed up to Mama June's for Christmas this year? She's already asking.
Wouldn't miss it. Donna and the kids are coming too. We'll be in Harlan by the 24th.
Good deal. I got a load running near Knoxville Thursday, might swing by the office.
Come by, I'll buy you lunch at Oakwood Diner.
Mentorship cohort is at six now. You still good to take broker authority week one?
Yes sir. Bren's putting the schedule together this week.
Perfect. Let's grab a Maker's at The Back Porch after poker Thursday and hash out the rest.
Sounds about right. I'll be there.
Marco, got a load Chattanooga to Detroit, automotive parts, pickup Thursday AM. You got a truck?
I can cover it. Ridgeline has a truck repositioning right through there.
Rate con coming over from Lorrie at $2,150. Need your current COI on file first.
Already emailed it to her this morning. We're good to go.
Anybody running empty out of Memphis this weekend? Got reefer freight to Nashville.
I might have a building supply load that pairs with it. Let me check with Pete and get back to you.
I've got a truck in Memphis Saturday if the rate works.
Appreciate it fellas. This network beats load boards any day.
Reminder the TN Freight Assoc conference is Oct 10 at the Volunteer Conference Center. Get registered.
Already on my calendar. Be good to see everybody there.
Spot rate alert: Knoxville to Atlanta dry van up 4% week over week, avg $2.18/mi.
Spot rate alert: Memphis to Nashville reefer steady, avg $2.62/mi.
That Knoxville to Atlanta bump is good news for the auto parts lanes.
Agreed. I'm holding my trucks for it instead of taking the cheap Florida freight.
Travis, did Cumberland Auto Parts confirm the Friday pickup window? Glen wanted it before noon.
Yes sir, confirmed 9 to 11 AM. Ridgeline truck is set, COI's current.
Good work. Have Lorrie send the rate con and loop Brand in so he sees the whole flow.
Will do. I'll walk him through the carrier packet too.
Don't forget Cody's got football conditioning at 5, you said you'd grab him.
Got it on my calendar. I'll wrap up with the carriers by 4:30 and head out.
Thank you hon. Pulled a pork shoulder out for you to smoke Saturday.
Now you're talking. I'll get the hickory going early.
New to the group, Roy Mullins out of Morristown. Got two dry vans I keep on the Knoxville-Atlanta run.
Welcome Roy. Keith vouched for you. I'll have lanes for you most weeks on that corridor.
Appreciate it Floyd. Send em my way anytime.
You still bringing the smoker for the fall cookout? Mama June wants ribs.
Loading it up. Tell her I'll do a couple racks and a brisket.
She'll be tickled. See you Oct 17.
